DLC2316:3:t_2:69.en:
$$チコ$$
「You birdbrain! Obviously, I'm going to be the pilot!」

DLC2316:3:t_2:73.en:
$$ノノ$$
「What you said yesterday... What did you mean, the $$トップレス$$ can't do anything?」

DLC2316:3:t_2:75.en:
$$チコ$$
「We can't make people happy... We can't cure sick people... We can't put an end to crime...」

DLC2316:3:t_2:76.en:
$$チコ$$
「We can't stop wars... We can't see people who've died...」

DLC2316:3:t_2:77.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But the $$トップレス$$ can protect peace, can't they?」

DLC2316:3:t_2:80.en:
$$チコ$$
「And even if we can protect peace, we still haven't managed to wipe out the $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

DLC2316:3:t_2:81.en:
$$チコ$$
「I can't stand making promises we can't keep.」

DLC2316:3:t_2:82.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But if we keep fighting with hard work and guts, someday...」

DLC2316:3:t_2:83.en:
$$チコ$$
「I don't want to make irresponsible promises like that!」

DLC2316:3:t_2:85.en:
$$チコ$$
「Could you promise to make snow fall on the moon?! You couldn't, could you?!」

DLC2316:3:t_2:86.en:
$$チコ$$
「The oath ceremony is the same thing! That's why...!」

DLC2316:3:t_2:90.en:
$$チコ$$
「These... Someone gave them to me.」

DLC2316:3:t_2:93.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Two circles and a crescent... Are they the sun, Earth and the moon?」

DLC2316:3:t_2:97.en:
$$チコ$$
「$$宇宙怪獣$$...! The $$木星急行$$'s main force is finally here!」

DLC2316:3:t_3:5.en:
$$チコ$$
「Move, new girl. I'm the one piloting $$キャトフヴァンディス$$.」

DLC2316:3:t_3:8.en:
$$ノノ$$
「All you think about is your score! All you think about is yourself! A $$バスターマシン$$ won't awaken for someone like that!」

DLC2316:3:t_3:10.en:
$$チコ$$
「I want to stop her saying those things at the oath ceremony! That the $$トップレス$$ can make everyone happy... It's a lie!」

DLC2316:3:t_3:12.en:
$$チコ$$
「...The person who made these earrings... had cosmic radiation sickness...」

DLC2316:3:t_3:14.en:
$$チコ$$
「I was a child... I told him... I'd cure his illness with my $$トップレス$$ powers...」

DLC2316:3:t_3:15.en:
$$チコ$$
「I lied! I hurt him! Even though I loved him...!」

DLC2316:3:t_3:16.en:
$$チコ$$
「The $$トップレス$$ are powerless! We can't save anyone!」

DLC2316:3:t_3:17.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...Do you really believe that? Are you all right with that?」

DLC2316:3:t_3:19.en:
$$ノノ$$
「A $$バスターマシン$$ won't lend its strength to someone who can't believe in herself!」

DLC2316:3:t_3:20.en:
$$ノノ$$
「What do you want to do?」

DLC2316:3:t_3:22.en:
$$カシオ$$
「$$キャトフヴァンディス$$ moved!」

DLC2316:3:t_3:25.en:
$$チコ$$
「Ghh...! But...! I didn't want him... to hate me...!」

DLC2316:3:t_4:3.en: ~$$マクロス・クォーター$$ - Hangar~

DLC2316:3:t_4:5.en:
$$チコ$$
「Wh-what?! I don't need your weird sympathy or anything!」

DLC2316:3:t_4:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「You're always mouthing off, but you're surprisingly romantic at heart.」

DLC2316:3:t_4:7.en:
$$チコ$$
「That was a long time ago.」

DLC2316:3:t_4:8.en:
$$アルト$$
「Still, I never knew you and $$ノノ$$ had a story like that...」

DLC2316:3:t_4:9.en:
$$ノノ$$
「A hero of justice needs both a big sister and a rival to grow!」

DLC2316:3:t_4:10.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Grow, huh... Your fighting strength aside, that brain of yours is still the same old birdbrain.」

DLC2316:3:t_4:11.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's mean, Onee-sama! $$ノノ$$'s still got plenty of growing to do!」

DLC2316:3:t_4:12.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ will keep running until the day she catches up to $$ノノリリ$$!」

DLC2316:3:t_4:13.en:
$$ノノ$$
「And I'll grow and grow, until in the end, I'll be even bigger than the Earth...」

DLC2316:3:t_4:14.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That's enough fantasizing. The next battle will be coming soon.」

DLC2316:3:t_4:15.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes, Onee-sama! From now on, $$ノノ$$ will do her best to help you in battle, too!」

DLC2316:3:t_4:16.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Then I'll be counting on you, $$ノノ$$.」

DLC2316:3:t_4:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...The past hidden in $$チコ$$'s earrings... A tender first love fades away like snow out of season...」

DLC2316:3:t_4:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But those memories shaped $$チコ$$... The boy's feelings have never vanished. They still live on in the girl's heart...」

DLC2316:3:t_4:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How unlike me... I've gotten sentimental, too...」

DLC2316:3:t_4:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And with that, everyone... Until we meet again.」

DLC2316:4:t_001:0.en:
$$チコ$$
「What a haul!! Keep this up, and I can overtake $$ラルク$$!」

DLC2316:4:t_002:0.en:
$$チコ$$
「Reinforcements! Not what I needed right now!」

DLC2316:4:t_004:0.en:
$$チコ$$
「Ghh...! They've come to finish me off!」

review.context: Tycho reveals her guilt over promising to cure a boy she loved. Nono challenges her to believe in herself; their present-day recollection closes before a battle flashback to Tycho's rescue.
decisions: Tycho's statement that she cannot now know the earrings' symbolism is rendered through the established fact that their maker has died.
Nono's claim to become bigger than Earth retains the source's foreshadowing without explanation.
Birdbrain carries the recurring albatross/dumb-bird insult naturally.
